name: Asobe Houri
source:
Second-yeah student. Member of the Sewing Club.

She's the type of girl who handles everything with ease and also excels at studying. She studies diligently to avoid any complaints from coming her way.

Fashion is her passion, and she loves to dress up. She goes all out with makeup and accessories, to the point where people say she looks like a completely different person without them.

Her actions may seem carefree and unrestrained, but she's always mindful of the limits. She has the school rules completely memorized and is careful not to break them. Her friends and teachers alike suggest she'd make a great lawyer because of her sharp mind.

She wants to form an idol group with Sumika and Mirai.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/13.html]official website[/url]]
